Q: Deploying Django backend and React frontend completely free — production-ready options? A:

For hosting Django backend i guess you have many, many options.

I personally use docker image hosted in Azure as App Service. It costs nothing. However I believe you can explore more hosting options here.

So first I would create docker image out of your Django app. For hosting docker images, docker hub is best place, as it's free. Azure container registry costs a lot, as for small project.

Frontend - here you have even more options. I have React frontend app hosted again as docker image on Azure. Same story as above.

However, here you also have other - Vercel or Cloudflare, to name a few.

Both, Vercel and Cloudflare are free.

Here you have list of "React friendly" options for hosting and deployments.

When it comes to database, I have only seen so far only one database hosting, that's free. It's Neon DB, which is Postgres database (you can manage it from web app in browser, or even connect to it with pgAdmin).

Q: How to link dynamic lib into flutter-desktop in Linux A:

for open a dynamic library only by they name like we do in a flutter plugin is very simple

  • The fist step is copy your shared object file (e.g lib.so ) to the folder linux or an other sub-path

  • And in your CMakeLists.txt file add this code :

# other codes
# ...

set(YOUR_LIBRARY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib.so") # <-- set the sub-paths after the '/'

# afert this point
# set(INSTALL_BUNDLE_LIB_DIR ...
# add :

install(FILES "${YOUR_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION "${INSTALL_BUNDLE_LIB_DIR}"
  COMPONENT Runtime)

After that your shared object file will appear in build/linux/.../lib. When you build, compile and run the flutter.

Q: How to update all Azure Powershell Az modules? A:

Update all modules

Get-Module -Name Az.* -ListAvailable | ForEach-Object { Update-Module -Name $_.Name -Force }

Uninstall old versions

Get-Module -Name Az.* -ListAvailable | 
Where-Object { $_.Version -ne (Get-InstalledModule -Name $_.Name).Version } |
ForEach-Object { Uninstall-Module -Name $_.Name -RequiredVersion $_.Version -Force }

Q: Data Engineering Internship A:

I totally agree, but he might be referring specifically to entry-level roles, especially given the high expectations for freshers due to AI.

These days, freshers are generally expected to know almost everything related to the field they’re applying for. If they don’t, they might not even land an interview. I’m currently looking for entry-level or mid-level roles in Go (Golang), and the market feels extremely overhyped because of AI.

3–4 years ago, someone only needed to know the basics to land a job. Now, the expectations are much higher, the requirements feel overwhelming, and in many cases, the pay is even lower.

It just feels unusually demanding compared to how things used to be.
